text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold's Senior year has finally 
arrived—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Stay Gold rarely invites anyone, but 
she asked if I wanted to go for Hatsumode, 
so we went out during the night, but—
choice_data_list: (We sure came a long way again...)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"Phew... The air is so crisp and 
refreshing..."
choice_data_list:
So, what kind of place are we going to 
today?

So, what kind of place are we going to 
today?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: I don't really get it either.
choice_data_list: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it there's a phantom shrine deep 
in the mountains around here.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Wouldn't it be interesting if we paid a 
visit there?
choice_data_list: Well, that may be true, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"It does feel like we have pretty little 
information to go on. Looks like we're in 
for a little adventure right at the start 
of the year...!"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Don't worry about it. If we don't find it, 
we can just say we came to worship the 
beautiful sunrise. For now, let's just go 
take a look.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, as we made our way along the 
mountain trail and the sun began to peek 
over the horizon—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Hm. The fog is quite thick.
choice_data_list:
My phone has no signal either. I have no 
idea where we are...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Well, let's try aiming for a spot with a 
good view. If we do that, we might figure 
something out.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"The fog is thick, so don't wander too 
far. If you get separated, we're seriously 
in trouble."
choice_data_list: Understood...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"And so, Stay Gold and I carefully made 
our way through the foggy forest—"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Alright, the fog is starting to clear—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: This is......—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We've come out into an open area, but... 
it's strangely quiet. And for some reason, 
it makes me want to straighten my posture.
choice_data_list: Is this... the phantom shrine...?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
......No. Doesn't seem like it. This 
feeling is—

—Under normal circumstances, this is 
forbidden ground.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
Yet on occasion, individuals like 
yourselves are drawn here by fate and 
appear before me...

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose I should say 'welcome'.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...When had she gotten there? An elderly 
Umamusume clad in a kimono stood before 
me. Her dignified presence made me 
strangely nervous...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me. I didn't know this area was 
off-limits. ...Should I leave right away?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
No. There is no need for that. This, too, 
is a matter of destiny. It would be wise 
to offer your prayers.
choice_data_list: Um... what should I pray for?

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text: For instance, about the journey ahead.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Trainer. Why don't we take them up on 
their offer and let them pray for us?"

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You don't often get to experience a New 
Year's shrine visit like this.
choice_data_list: That... I guess so, but—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Now then, what should I wish for...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Following Stay Gold's lead, I should 
calmly make a wish for the journey ahead 
as well. The first thing that came to mind 
was—
choice_data_list:
A strong body that keeps on marching 
forward

The strength and skill to overcome 
difficulties.
A mindset that lets you enjoy everything

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...So that our journey may continue 
onward without ever being broken."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I prayed fervently that Stay Gold's body 
would remain healthy and strong.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. That's quite an elaborate 
prayer."
choice_data_list: Stay Gold, what did you pray for?
Stay Gold, what did you pray for?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It's a secret.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...So that no matter what hardships lie 
ahead, she will be able to overcome them."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I wished for Stay Gold to grow even 
stronger, and that I would be able to help 
her grow.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. That's quite an elaborate 
prayer."
choice_data_list: Stay Gold, what did you pray for?
Stay Gold, what did you pray for?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It's a secret.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...So that no matter what lies ahead, 
Stay Gold can enjoy it."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I prayed that her heart would remain as 
pure gold as ever, and that I too could 
stay that way.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
"...Haha. That's quite an elaborate 
prayer."
choice_data_list: Stay Gold, what did you pray for?
Stay Gold, what did you pray for?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: It's a secret.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
...Pardon me, Umamusume. May I ask your 
name?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...Stay Gold.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold-san. ...It seems you are 
connected by quite a great many bonds.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
And now, those bonds have formed a massive 
vortex, turning into chaos.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
—Enough to disrupt the very laws of the 
world.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
...Allow me to ask, out of concern for 
you.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text: Do you intend to carry on like this?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Yeah. I intend to enjoy the journey 
ahead.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
"...If you wish to return, head straight 
in that direction. It should take you down 
to the foot of the mountain."
choice_data_list: Oh, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Elderly Umamusume in Kimono
text_block_list.text:
May you have a wonderful journey. May 
fortune smile upon the bonds you forge—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
In the next moment, a ferocious gust of 
wind blew, so intense that I couldn't even 
keep my eyes open...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Covering my face with my arms to weather 
the wind, I opened my eyes once I felt it 
calm down—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: ...No one's here.
choice_data_list: It vanished...!?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
...Well, that's just how it is in the 
mountains. Best not to overthink it.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Alright, let's head back like they said. 
It wouldn't be nice to cause a ruckus 
here, after all.
choice_data_list: ...Ah, yeah.
...Y-Yeah.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After that, I re-entered the deep, foggy 
forest and headed straight in the 
direction pointed out by the old 
Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Just how long had I been walking? Before 
I knew it, I had made it through the 
forest and down to the foot of the 
mountain...

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Phew, made it back in one piece.
choice_data_list: What in the world was that place...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Besides, just who on earth was that 
elderly Umamusume—

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Who knows? But hey, it was definitely 
worth praying back there.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That should be fine for today, right? We 
got to experience something interesting, 
after all.
choice_data_list: Well... I suppose that's true too.
Well... I guess that's true too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Ever since meeting Stay Gold, I 
secretly realize that I've grown 
accustomed to adapting quickly to the 
strangest things.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Ah~, but man, I'm starving~. Let's go grab 
a bite nearby.
choice_data_list:
I wonder if there's anywhere to eat around 
here...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...In the end, Stay Gold and I would 
wander around looking for a place to eat 
for a while longer—
